# N14 auxiliary iid: exact 57th optimal affine segment

**2026-10-24 | Author-level exact finite-model proof | NOT independently reviewed or native-BRC validated.**

## Model and inherited data

The three iid symbol laws are P=(1/8,1/24,5/6) and Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6), with horizon N=14 and arbitrary history-dependent randomized stopping and decisions. Define eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), and tP,tQ the expected sample counts. The objective is V14(alpha)=inf[max(tP,tQ):eP,eQ<=alpha].

Inherited author-checked 56th endpoint:
- alpha56=1292959592044044215/3725075438477770752;
- V56=24713151556465630757/1862537719238885376;
- s56=6485231369528539/10444800000000000, immediate-Q probability at B=(12,0,1).

The 56th endpoint has already committed A56=(9,0,2) to immediate Q. Other forced actions are the finite explicit stop sets and stop formula in the portable checker (adapted from the immutable 56th author checker).

## Exact theorem

Let K57=6854544972/576215, lambdaQ=K57, lambdaP=72+(8/9)K57=6134416344/576215 and Gamma=lambdaP+lambdaQ=764056548/33895. Let eta57=29658125/570630428688384.

**For every REAL delta with 0<=delta<=eta57,**

    V14(alpha56+delta) = V56-Gamma*delta.

The exact right endpoint and value are:

    alpha57=1292959785652284215/3725075438477770752,
    V57=24710969410964542757/1862537719238885376.

The claimed sharpness is for this particular dual supporting affine line, not for the domain of the entire value function.

## Proof I: Bellman lower bound under all history-dependent policies

For count state (n,a,b) (numbers of total samples and first/second symbols), the likelihood ratio Q(h)/P(h)=2^(a+b)/3^a is the same for every ordered history with those counts. For the P-measure Lagrangian define at each state

    D(x)=min{lambdaQ*2^(a+b)/3^a [decide P],
             lambdaP [decide Q],
             1+sum_i P_i*D(x+i) [continue]},

omitting continuation when n=14. Backward induction on the actual full-history tree is justified because the conditional iid future, likelihood ratio, and available actions depend only on the count state; randomization cannot beat the minimum. Exact rational exhaustive evaluation of all 680 states and 1240 comparisons against the selected actions returns 1238 strictly positive gaps, 0 negative gaps, and exactly two ties: C/P at A57=(8,5,0) and C/Q at B=(12,0,1). The root is

    D(root)=98956954714467349198128685/12626143198720403963904
           =V56+Gamma*alpha56.

Hence for any history-adaptive randomized policy with both errors at most alpha,

    D(root)<=tP+lambdaP*eP+lambdaQ*eQ
           <=max(tP,tQ)+Gamma*alpha,

so V14(alpha)>=D(root)-Gamma*alpha.

## Proof II: exact first hits and primal strategy

Under the *actual inherited stop tree*, all 56 nominal length-eight words leading to A57 are genuine first arrivals, with probability mass

    pA=875/884736, qA=875/6718464.

All 12 length-twelve nominal words leading to B are first arrivals, with

    pB=48828125/725594112, qB=48828125/362797056.

When continuing at each of the two tie sites, the exact conditional quadruple (eP,eQ,tP,tQ) equals

    cA=(85259/191102976,2974741/2985984,9146891/7962624,329195/248832),
    cB=(63/64,1/144,9/8,13/12).

The two first-arrival cylinders are disjoint: A57 already contains five type-0 symbols and B has zero; B is later and cannot feed back into A. Their likelihood ratio is constant within each count-state, so any history-specific tie randomization can be represented by one probability-weighted effective u,s in [0,1].

At A57 take immediate P with probability u. At B take immediate Q with probability s. Define the positive exact coefficients

    X=pA*cA.eP=74601625/169075682574336,
    Y=qA*(1-cA.eQ)=9837625/20061226008576,
    E=pB*(1-cB.eP)=48828125/46438023168,
    H=qB*cB.eQ=48828125/52242776064.

The two errors are exactly

    eP-alpha56=-X*u+E*(s-s56),
    eQ-alpha56= Y*u-H*(s-s56).

Choose s=s56+h57*u, with h57=(X+Y)/(E+H)=18012071/38400000000. Both errors then equal alpha56+eta57*u because

    eta57=-X+E*h57=Y-H*h57=29658125/570630428688384.

The entire range is feasible: s increases from s56 to s57=6490130652840539/10444800000000000, still strictly between 0 and 1. Exact forward absorption gives tP=V56-Gamma*eta57*u. The affine margin tP-tQ is positive at both endpoints:

    margin(0)=984596181247775843/1862537719238885376,
    margin(1)=327620777400053281/620845906412961792.

Hence tP=max(tP,tQ) for every real u in [0,1]. We attain the Bellman lower bound everywhere on the claimed interval.

## Proof III: sharpness of the right endpoint

Finite-horizon randomized-policy occupation measures form a compact polytope, so the optimum is attained. Equality with the same affine lower bound for alpha>alpha57 would require both eP=eQ=alpha because both multipliers are strictly positive, and only Bellman-minimizing actions at all reached histories. Every action is forced except the two reported ties. Using their disjoint first-hit cylinders and fixed likelihood ratios, even history-dependent randomization reduces to effective u,s in [0,1]. Error equality then forces s=s56+h57*u and alpha=alpha56+eta57*u<=alpha57: contradiction. Therefore the same affine line is not optimal strictly to the right.

## Reproducibility, provenance and limits

The inherited 56th author checker was rerun locally with exact fractions. The 57th primary checker separately evaluates all 680 Bellman states/1240 comparisons, first-hit masses, suffix risks, the primal forward recurrences and seven exact mixtures. A second author-side checker enumerates ordered words (3^8 and 3^12), separately minimizes Bellman, checks four-corner backward risk recurrences and seven mixtures. Local checks passed. Both reuse the inherited stop-action set; this is not independent Research Driver review.

The BRC/observer discipline retained actual ordered-history provenance until first stop, and quotient to count states was used only where the iid likelihood-ratio/future-law factorization makes it valid. This auxiliary iid decision-theory model has **no proved map** to native positive BRC, X6, P000 triadic equilibrium, three-dimensional native slices or Heartbeat dynamics. Native control dispatch returned CONTROL_QUOTA; no owner/CLAIM, formal Task Result, Driver acceptance or Lean formalization is asserted.

Inherited 56th author proof: research_notes/2026-10-23_N14_auxiliary_iid_56th_exact_affine_AUTHOR_UNREVIEWED.md at 6ef3c2734b27007aa49fe523c718bcb2e191df6a. Global read snapshot main@0d1a36da02cbd766d83a625e62c9a47076edd4e5; initial EM read snapshot main@6c6e3f37d66d64b793ed58c4dbbf4f5d166c9744.

**Next unproved dual crossing only:** K58=11042892/1007, at A58=(10,6,1), continue versus immediate P after fixing A57 to immediate P. Real first arrivals, balance corrections, right breakpoint and the full 58th interval remain to be computed and proved.
